# Glass, Color and Hardware Option Prices per Opening

Options price list for Window Replacement Contracts. Every option is priced per opening, by Ridgeline series.

| Series | Premium triple-silver Low-E | Triple-pane glass | Grilles between the glass | Non-white exterior color available | Non-white exterior color |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | $64.00 | $142.00 | $48.00 | No | $0.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | $58.00 | $128.00 | $52.00 | Yes | $118.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | $52.00 | $118.00 | $56.00 | Yes | $108.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | $0.00 | $134.00 | $72.00 | Yes | $96.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | $0.00 | $156.00 | $84.00 | Yes | $88.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $0.00 | $189.00 | $96.00 | Yes | $142.00 |

| Series | Tempered safety glass | Laminated glass | Obscure (privacy) glass | Upgraded lock and hardware finish |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | $86.00 | $164.00 | $39.00 | $24.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | $86.00 | $164.00 | $39.00 | $24.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | $92.00 | $172.00 | $42.00 | $28.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | $98.00 | $186.00 | $46.00 | $32.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | $104.00 | $198.00 | $49.00 | $32.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $112.00 | $214.00 | $55.00 | $44.00 |

## Notes to the price list

- A premium Low-E price of $0.00 means the premium triple-silver Low-E package is already standard in that series.
- A non-white exterior color can be ordered only where the series shows it as available; an exterior color price of $0.00 appears where it is unavailable.
- Each figure is a price per opening, so an option on several openings is that price for each opening it covers.
